title: Cloning a Repository
objective: Push a repository to a shared bare copy, clone it into a second folder, and print the clone's history.
hint: Commit the README, make the bare shared.git, add origin, and push with -u. Then git clone -q with the full path to shared.git and the full path to the clone folder. Then Write-Output with (git -C and the clone folder, then log --format=%s).
